subject: 68 days of healing unlocked
preview_text: You’ve been with us for 68 days. Here’s a gift only long-term users get.
body_paragraphs: 68 days ago you downloaded Fresh Start. Let me guess: back then, you couldn’t imagine feeling okay again. I remember that feeling. It’s like your ex is still in the room, even when they’re gone. But you stayed. You showed up. And that takes guts.

I’m writing this because you deserve more than a generic thank-you. You’ve logged late-night spirals, tracked mood dips, and probably cursed at your no-contact streak a few times. So I’m giving you something only people who’ve made it this far get: exclusive insider access to our next tool.

We built a hidden feature called the 3AM Emergency Mode upgrade. It’s a personal AI therapist that talks you down when obsessive thoughts hit hardest. It learns your breakup type and customizes every response. Right now, it’s only live for users who’ve been with us 60+ days. You’re one of them.

Open the app, tap the new ‘Gratitude Key’ icon on your home screen. It unlocks the upgrade instantly. P.S. — The first 50 users who try it also get a free personalized coping playlist. That’s just for you.
